title: Competency Development and Implementation
overview: Transforming human resources into a data-driven, systematic approach is the next step in advancing HR practices. Competency-based HR solutions provide organizations and line managers with the tools needed to foster strategic partnerships. This course introduces the concept of competencies and provides practical guidance on how to implement them across HR functions. You will gain a clear understanding of competencies, empowering you to confidently apply this essential concept in your HR department and align it with organizational practices.
audience: This course is ideal for managers, supervisors, administrators, specialists, team leaders, business partners, and officers involved in human resources, training, and development.
methodology: The course incorporates a blend of presentations, analysis, and hands-on development activities. While brief lectures are included, the emphasis is on practical applications, group exercises, and gamified activities to enhance learning outcomes.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Define competencies, explore their origins, and understand their role within HR and the organization
Break down the components of a competency and differentiate between them
Design and implement competency frameworks by aligning them with business goals
Apply competencies in recruitment and selection processes
Utilize competencies to assess training needs, identify talent pools, and create succession plans
Integrate competencies and behavioral indicators into performance appraisal systems

items.text: Recruitment, training, performance management, and compensation cycles
Distinguishing between knowledge, skills, and competencies
Competency job profiles vs. job descriptions
Understanding HR strategies, vision, and mission statements
Identifying critical success factors and key result areas
Traditional vs. competency-based Training Needs Analysis (TNA)
Advantages and challenges of competency-based appraisals
